contexts.text: He was more deceitful than they, which he showed by rolling himself into the form of a spiral.
Like raising a weight by screws.
The trees... ran... in gyres as of a perpetual spiral: it was a perfect arboreal spiral...
Palms and laurels planted in the gyres of spirals.
As the spiritual organism of the mind consists of perpetual spirals, it would coil itself up into spires, and would writhe like a serpent...
Such is the flux of the endeavours and forces... by spirals from left to right towards their centres...
She showed herself... in a long form of a spiral; (and then) as a long solid spiral; by which it was shown that she was among the more deceitful. SE 4424.
